name: gmail-mcp
description: Gmail (messaging): me, list_inbound, get_thread, mark_read. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint

platform_mcp_gmail_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GMAIL_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_gmail_client_id.description: OAuth 2.0 client id (Google Cloud console, Clients page) of the app the user consented to.

platform_mcp_gmail_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_gmail_client_secret.description: The OAuth client's secret; sent with client_id, refresh_token and grant_type=refresh_token in the form body of POST https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token (https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2/web-server#offline).

platform_mcp_gmail_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GMAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_gmail_refresh_token.description: Refresh token from a one-time authorization-code consent with access_type=offline and the scopes https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.modify (or gmail.readonly for reading only). 'Refresh tokens are valid until the user revokes access or the refresh token expires'; the runtime mints 1-hour access tokens from it.

tools.name: me
tools.description: users.getProfile: account carries emailAddress, messagesTotal, threadsTotal, historyId.

tools.name: list_inbound
tools.description: users.messages.list with labelIds=INBOX: 'each message resource contains only an id and a threadId' — read the text with get_thread. Gmail pages by pageToken, so `page` is ignored (first `limit` messages only); `since` is not sent; total is Gmail's resultSizeEstimate.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: users.threads.get?format=metadata: every message of the thread with `snippet` ('a short part of the message text') as text and internalDate (epoch milliseconds) as sent_at; From/To/Subject are in raw.payload.headers. `page`/`limit` are ignored (the whole thread is returned).

tools.name: mark_read
tools.description: users.messages.modify with removeLabelIds ["UNREAD"]; `message_id` is required, `thread_id` and `channel` are not used.
